items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Wally Pepp, I've heard him. I don't think you ever heard him. No. [INTERVIEWEE] He doesn't know him from Mexico.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. He was bass, turn it, spin it, slap it.
Wally Pepp, I've heard him. I don't think you ever heard him. No.
He doesn't know him from Mexico. But one time that was to create some sort of show business, or to retain himself to have the audience pay attention to what he was doing.
